# Google Labs
> Google Labs is Google’s home for AI experiments, prototypes, and early-access tools exploring creative, productive, and responsible uses of AI.

Google Labs showcases experimental products and research-driven experiences from Google, with a focus on generative AI, multimodal creation, and practical workflows. The site highlights hands-on tools, experiment collections, announcements, and community programs that help people explore emerging AI capabilities.

## Main
- [Google Labs Home](https://labs.google/): Landing page for Google Labs experiments, featured tools, and latest AI projects.
- [Experiments](https://labs.google/experiments): Directory of Google Labs experiments and prototypes across creativity, productivity, and exploration.
- [About](https://labs.google/about): Overview of Google Labs, its mission, and how Google approaches AI experimentation.
- [Community](https://labs.google/community): Community hub with ways to connect, share feedback, and follow Google Labs activity.

## AI Tools and Experiments
- [ImageFX](https://labs.google/fx/tools/image-fx): Experimental text-to-image tool for generating and refining visual concepts.
- [MusicFX](https://labs.google/fx/tools/music-fx): Experimental music generation tool for creating original audio from text prompts.
- [TextFX](https://labs.google/fx/tools/text-fx): Writing and language experiment built to inspire creative text generation.
- [Whisk](https://labs.google/whisk): Visual ideation experiment for remixing and exploring image-based concepts.
- [NotebookLM](https://labs.google/notebooklm): AI-powered research and note-taking assistant grounded in user-provided sources.
- [Illuminate](https://labs.google/illuminate): Experimental learning tool that helps turn content into accessible audio discussions.

## Creative and Media Experiences
- [FX Tools](https://labs.google/fx): Hub for Google Labs generative media tools including image, music, and text experiments.
- [ImageFX Prompt Guide](https://labs.google/fx/tools/image-fx): Tool page for exploring prompt-based image generation workflows.
- [MusicFX Creation](https://labs.google/fx/tools/music-fx): Tool page for generating music clips and experimenting with style prompts.
- [TextFX Writing Tools](https://labs.google/fx/tools/text-fx): Tool page featuring creative language experiments for writers and creators.

## Learning and Research
- [NotebookLM](https://labs.google/notebooklm): Research assistant for summarizing, organizing, and querying uploaded materials.
- [Illuminate](https://labs.google/illuminate): Learning experiment for transforming information into conversational audio summaries.
- [Experiments](https://labs.google/experiments): Browse current and past experiments relevant to learning, productivity, and discovery.

## Community and Participation
- [Community](https://labs.google/community): Official community page with channels for updates, discussion, and participation.
- [About](https://labs.google/about): Background on Google Labs and its approach to building experimental AI experiences.
- [Google Labs Home](https://labs.google/): Starting point for discovering featured experiments and newly launched tools.

## Featured Collections
- [FX](https://labs.google/fx): Collection of generative AI tools focused on image, music, and text creation.
- [Experiments](https://labs.google/experiments): Central catalog for browsing Google Labs prototypes and featured launches.
- [Whisk](https://labs.google/whisk): Featured visual experiment for playful image exploration and remixing.
- [NotebookLM](https://labs.google/notebooklm): Featured productivity and research tool for source-grounded AI assistance.

## Responsible Exploration
- [About](https://labs.google/about): Explains the goals of Google Labs and the context behind its AI experiments.
- [Google Labs Home](https://labs.google/): Highlights Google’s experimental AI work and responsible exploration themes.
- [Community](https://labs.google/community): Feedback and participation channels for engaging with experimental products.
